report.scope: Actual two-sampler half-cycle cascade:30HBT/28nativeR/2nativeMIM. First sampler rising-edge; second physically connected to first and falling-edge. External8GHz clock,10ohmsources,500uA per sampler,150fF on all four outputs.256original bits and clean native startup. No ideal internal bit regeneration. Not phase detector, closed-loop recovery or physical/x4PHY acceptance.
